# Feature: Testimonials

## Overview
Create a dynamic testimonial system that showcases real customer success stories and social proof, helping to build trust and demonstrate value across different industries.

## User Stories

1. Testimonial Display
   - As a website visitor
   - I want to see relevant customer testimonials
   - So that I can trust the product's effectiveness

2. Industry-Specific Stories
   - As a potential customer
   - I want to see success stories from my industry
   - So that I can understand how the product works for my business type

3. Social Proof Management
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to manage and update testimonials
   - So that we can showcase our latest success stories

4. Case Study Integration
   - As a marketing team member
   - I want to create detailed case studies
   - So that we can demonstrate deep value propositions

5. Review Integration
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to display third-party reviews
   - So that we can show independent validation

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create testimonial management interface
- [ ] Build dynamic testimonial carousel
- [ ] Implement industry filtering system
- [ ] Create case study template system
- [ ] Integrate third-party review platforms
- [ ] Add testimonial submission system
- [ ] Implement approval workflow
- [ ] Create media attachment handling
- [ ] Add analytics tracking
- [ ] Implement social sharing

## Acceptance Criteria
- Testimonials display properly
- Industry filtering works correctly
- Case studies are easily navigable
- Review integrations function properly
- Media loads efficiently
- Analytics track engagement
- Mobile-responsive design
- Proper attribution displayed

## Technical Notes
- Use lazy loading for images
- Implement proper carousel accessibility
- Cache testimonial data
- Use responsive images
- Implement proper schema markup
- Use background jobs for media processing

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- Landing Page feature
- Content Management system
- SEO & Performance requirements
